Sector values decide where to request candidates, not certified spectral exclusion. Missing pairs use the original driver recovery.
Outer factor statistics exclude inner sector solves; their costs remain in parent time_total_s/time_iterate_s and detailed stderr records.
The two physical photonic inputs have incomplete external references.
No sparse matrix is densified by the solver. Dense full-spectrum reference is used only for new test matrices of order <=420.
